caseName: National Refining Co. v. Pennsylvania Petroleum Co.
caseNameFull: National Refining Co. v. Pennsylvania Petroleum Co.
attorneys: Messrs. I. J. Ringolskyand Harry L. Jacobs for petitioners. Mr. Floyd E. Jacobs for respondent.

opinions.text:
On consideration of the motion of counsel for the petitioners, it is ordered that the passage in respondent’s brief, at pages 50 to 53 thereof, of which *668complaint, is made, be and it is hereby stricken from the files. National Surety Co. v. Jarvis, 278 U.S. 610, 611. The petition for writ of certiorari is denied.

Messrs. I. J. Ringolskyand Harry L. Jacobs for petitioners. Mr. Floyd E. Jacobs for respondent.
